en: Black‑and‑white military postcard showing a temporary pontoon bridge over a river. Soldiers in early‑20th‑century uniforms are marching across the bridge, while several officers stand at the near end. Small boats are lashed together supporting the wooden roadway. On the opposite bank there is open countryside with a few tall trees and low buildings. Red printed German text appears along the top margin.
